changelog:
Added:
- Right-click menus on the creator profile — galleries, photos, videos and the Discovery row
- Videos as avatars & banners: scrub to any moment and capture a full-res frame or a 3s animated clip, with a premium frame-picker player
- Animated avatars now play while browsing the creator list
- Hovering a video now plays a live preview on the creator profile and Dashboard Discover, with duration badges
- Settings → Thumbnails: purge and regenerate image/video thumbnails separately — video thumbs are now clean edge-to-edge crops
- Photos/Videos pages: pagination on top too, plus a jump-to-page field

Fixed:
- 'Random from gallery' avatar did nothing when it picked a video
- Setting a banner from a video appeared to do nothing
- Video avatars are much sharper (full-res frames, 720p clips)
- Page changes now scroll back to the top; the pager can no longer strand you on an empty page

Changed:
- Creator profile tabs load everything with infinite scroll (no more 100-gallery cap) and default to Recently Added
- 'More Like This' picks fresh recommendations on every visit
